rules.rule: Santa Tracker server and route-handler review. Be strict and report every substantiated issue in the diff, focusing on substantive behavior and security defects. Check Next.js App Router server/client boundaries, route-handler authentication and authorization, admin JWT checks, validation at trust boundaries, data writes and snapshot history, R2/filesystem parity, caching and dynamic rendering, error responses, secret and personal-data handling, and behavior behind feature flags. For each finding give the path, changed line, concrete evidence, and user or operational impact. Review only changed code and behavior it directly affects; do not invent concerns in untouched code. Report only concrete bugs, security vulnerabilities, or correctness defects in changed code, with medium or higher severity. Suppress all low-severity findings and all nitpick, style, taste, accessibility-only, documentation-only, performance-only, test-only, and maintainability-only comments. Do not report hypothetical concerns or issues outside changed code and its direct behavior.

Santa Tracker React and Next.js component review. Be strict and report every substantiated correctness, accessibility, responsive-layout, state, or maintainability issue in the diff, focusing on substantive defects. Check keyboard and screen-reader support, labels and focus behavior, loading and error states, server/client component boundaries, reduced-motion and high-contrast behavior, and mobile layouts. Every finding needs the path, changed line, evidence, and user impact. Do not make taste-only comments or report problems outside the changed code and its direct behavior. Report only concrete bugs, security vulnerabilities, or correctness defects in changed code, with medium or higher severity. Suppress all low-severity findings and all nitpick, style, taste, accessibility-only, documentation-only, performance-only, test-only, and maintainability-only comments. Do not report hypothetical concerns or issues outside changed code and its direct behavior.

Review browser JavaScript and service-worker changes for stale caches, unsafe DOM injection, request handling, offline behavior, accessibility regressions, and accidental exposure of admin-only data. Report only concrete bugs, security vulnerabilities, or correctness defects in changed code, with medium or higher severity. Suppress all low-severity findings and all nitpick, style, taste, accessibility-only, documentation-only, performance-only, test-only, and maintainability-only comments. For scripts check argument handling, shell or path injection, destructive operations, failure handling, and whether generated data stays consistent with its schema. Every finding needs the path, changed line, evidence, and impact. Do not flag problems outside changed code and its direct effects. Report only concrete bugs, security vulnerabilities, or correctness defects in changed code, with medium or higher severity. Santa Tracker GitHub Actions review. Be strict. Check pull_request_target safety, never checking out or executing untrusted pull-request code with write permissions or secrets, minimal token permissions, pinned action SHAs for privileged workflows, secret handling, concurrency cancellation, timeouts, fork behavior, correct event/ref wiring, and whether a failing gate is actually required by the repository ruleset. Treat secret exposure, unsafe execution of PR code, or an ineffective claimed merge gate as high severity. Every finding needs path, line, evidence, and impact. Report only concrete bugs, security vulnerabilities, or correctness defects in changed code, with medium or higher severity. Suppress all low-severity findings and all nitpick, style, taste, accessibility-only, documentation-only, performance-only, test-only, and maintainability-only comments.
